assumptions: No third family is added. The small uppercase metadata labels in the sidrano and stodio references (dates, status, section index, location line) are set in Poppins 500 uppercase with wide tracking and tabular figures, which keeps the label role without a mono face

References are applied as composition and density guides, not colors: sidrano hero (bordered nav bar, large left headline with right supporting text and buttons, dotted rules), avoora work cards (full-bleed screenshot in a rounded frame with overlaid caption bar), mitchy about (headline plus photo with short paragraph), stodio footer (dark rounded panel)
The monumental red wordmark from the sidrano hero is not adopted, to avoid fanciness; the hero name stays large within the Poppins scale
Light-surface references (fabrica, meridian, stodio) are translated to dark surfaces because the existing identity is dark

creativeDirection.summary: A quiet dark technical portfolio where the topographic contour field is the only atmosphere. Above it sit plain, well-spaced type and the real game screenshots, framed like level captures, with one blue beacon guiding the actions. It should read like a tidy engine tool, not a web showcase.

traits.quality: Technical clarity: tracked uppercase metadata, numbered sections, aligned grids
traits.boundary: not a code-themed gimmick (no terminal windows, fake code snippets or typing effects)

traits.quality: Atmospheric backdrop from the contour lines
traits.boundary: not competing with content; lines drop to low opacity behind cards and text
not decorated with gradients, tilts or neon glows

creativeDirection.productiveTension: A living, generative contour field (the motion and craft side of a gameplay programmer) against a strictly still, grid-disciplined content layer with flat surfaces and 1px borders

signatureDevice.description: The existing topographic contour canvas with a thick contour every third threshold. Its yellow-magenta-blue gradient is echoed once as a short horizontal rule under each section label, borrowing the sidrano reference's line-with-dot divider and a contour's thick index line.
invariants: Contour canvas only appears full-bleed behind the hero and dimmed (about 0.25 opacity) behind the rest of the page
Gradient hue order is always #EDD500 -> #FF006F -> #1723CC, top to bottom or left to right
Section rule is 1-2px tall and at most 96px wide; never used as a fill, button or text color
Contour lines never animate on mobile, under reduced motion or in hidden tabs

creativeDirection.restraint: The gradient lives only in the canvas and the short section rule. Every other surface is flat near-black with 1px neutral borders. Blue fills appear only on the primary button and active/focus states, and nothing glows.
avoid: Hairline grid systems absent from the references
Invented stats, testimonials or client logos

typefaces.source: Existing brand (style.css); Google Fonts https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Nunito, OFL https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/nunito

interfaceDirection: Spacing is an 8px base rhythm. Sections use clamp(72px, 10vw, 160px) vertical padding, content width is capped at 1240px, and gutters are clamp(20px, 5vw, 64px); above 2000px wide the root font size scales up (clamp on html font-size) so 4K never shows a tiny column. Type scale: hero name clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 5.5rem) Poppins 700, -0.02em tracking, sentence case; role line Poppins 500 clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.75rem) in textMuted; section headings clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.25rem) Poppins 600; body Nunito 400 1.0625rem with 1.65 line height and 65ch max; labels Poppins 500 0.75-0.8125rem uppercase with +0.1em tracking and font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Surfaces: pure black canvas with the contour field; cards and panels use a surface step derived from the neutral seed with a 1px divider border; surfaceAlt for nav bar and footer panel. No shadows: depth comes only from border and surface step. Radius family: 6px buttons, inputs and icon tiles; 12px cards and media frames; 20px footer panel. Nav follows sidrano: a full-width bar with a 1px border, wordmark left, links centered, social icon buttons right, collapsing to a hamburger and sheet below 900px. Hero follows sidrano: name and role left with dotted 1px rules above and below; location label and a row of 44px square tool-icon tiles right, stacked on mobile. About follows mitchy/meridian: heading and bio left, profile photo in a 12px-radius frame right, photo first on mobile. Projects follow avoora: each card is a 16:10 screenshot frame with a dark overlaid caption bar holding index (01), title and the uppercase status/date/role line; two columns on desktop, one on mobile, and the first project may span full width. Contact follows the obvia CTA: large heading, a 1px rule, then the form in a two-column field grid (Email + Subject, Message full width). Footer is a stodio-style dark rounded panel with nav links and social icons. Controls: primary button is a #1723CC fill with white Poppins 600 text and 6px radius, #380BBF on hover; secondary is transparent with a 1px controlBorder, accent border on hover. Focus is a 2px #6A72E6 outline with 3px offset on every interactive element. Inputs use a surface fill and 1px border, accent border on focus. Nav links are textMuted, text on hover, accentText with an underline when active. Cards respond to hover/focus with a 1px accent border while the screenshot scales to 1.03 inside its clipped frame. Recurring accent treatment: the caption-bar index number and the active card border.

imageDirection.summary: Real game screenshots and Marco's own photo carry all imagery; the contour canvas supplies atmosphere. No stock, generated people or decorative illustration.
subjects: Project screenshots from Media/Projects (Castlebound, Gunsmoke and Grimoires, Photon Dash, Slimy Files, Steelsilk Championship, Zombie FPS, MatchMaking/PlayFab)
Existing tool and social icon PNG/SVG files
imageDirection.treatment: Screenshots use object-fit: cover in a fixed 16:10 frame with 12px radius and a 1px divider border. A dark caption bar (surface at 88% opacity, no blur) is overlaid at the bottom, inset 12px, holding index, title and metadata, after the avoora reference. Images use loading=lazy, decoding=async, explicit width/height and sizes attributes. The profile photo sits in a 4:5 frame with the same radius. Tool icons sit centered at 60% size inside equal 44px square tiles on surfaceAlt so mismatched source icons read as one set.
avoid: Color overlays or duotone on screenshots

motionDirection.summary: Motion explains structure and confirms input while staying light for low-end PCs. The contour field provides ambient movement, so content motion is short, transform/opacity only, and runs once.
principles: Hero entrance to establish hierarchy, triggered on DOMContentLoaded after fonts are ready: wordmark, then name, role line and tool-icon tiles rise 16px and fade in, in sequence; 520-680ms each with 70ms stagger (240ms cap); strong ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1)
Contour canvas fade-in to avoid a blank-to-busy pop, triggered on the first rendered frame: canvas opacity rises from 0 to its target behind the hero; 700-800ms; gentle ease-out

Project card reveal to show the grid as a sequence, triggered by IntersectionObserver per card (threshold 0, rootMargin 0px 0px 10% 0px, unobserve on first hit, only for cards below the viewport at init): each card rises 24px and fades in while its screenshot settles from scale 1.04 to 1 inside the clipped frame; 560-720ms with 80ms stagger per row; ease-out

About reveal to pair photo with text, triggered by IntersectionObserver on the about group: the photo frame slides 24px in from its side while heading and bio fade up 12px, 80ms later; 500-650ms; ease-out

Contact reveal to lead the eye into the form, triggered by IntersectionObserver on the contact heading group: the heading fades up, the 1px rule scales in on the X axis from the left, then the form fields fade in; 450-600ms with 70ms stagger; ease-out

Button and card feedback to confirm hover and press, triggered on hover, focus-visible and active: background, border-color and transform (translateY -1px on hover, 0 on press) transition on named properties only; 140-200ms; ease-out

Navigation feedback to show state, triggered on link hover/focus and section change: underline scaleX 0 to 1 from the left plus color shift; 160-220ms; ease-out. The hamburger sheet opens with opacity and translateY(-8px to 0) while the icon morphs to close; 220-250ms; ease-out

Reduced motion to keep everything readable, triggered by prefers-reduced-motion including live changes: owned animations are cancelled, observers disconnected, all elements shown in final state, and the contour canvas draws one static frame; 0ms, immediate
avoid: A global opacity:0 reveal class in CSS
Transforms on ancestors of the fixed nav
Animating the canvas on mobile, under reduced motion or in hidden tabs

Rewriting the bio or project descriptions
